claim: Identity, aliases, hosting and discoverability are independent records.
Anonymous mode needs pairwise or contextual identities.
Federated hosting is a replaceable service binding.
Public identity is an explicit discoverability projection.
Persona, device and transport identities must be separate.
Device enrollment needs a trusted device or recovery material.
Publishing or merging personas creates lasting correlation.
Relay and discovery infrastructure is connectivity, not application identity authority.
